title: XML parser with entities enabled (csharp) — review required
description: An XML parser in csharp is configured to resolve entities or load DTDs: DtdProcessing.Parse. External entities in untrusted XML then read files and probe networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms the input is trusted or disables entities.
remediation: Disable DTDs and external entities (DtdProcessing.Prohibit) for any XML crossing a trust boundary.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of input trust. Factory-call XXE sinks are separate rules.
